blocks.html:
Chrome Trim Tesla Wrap

Small changes and updates can make a large impact on the overall look of a vehicle. This customer commissioned Vinyl Tesla Wrap Toronto to wrap all the chrome trim on his Tesla. After some discussion with our installation team, the owner decided on Avery Dennison Brush Black vinyl. We mainly use only 3M or Avery Dennison vinyl as we think they are the best on the market at the moment. They both have a variety of colours and finishes to suit our customer’s needs and desires. The chrome trim was standard on Tesla when the customer brought it using is a smartphone. Tesla is a beautiful car, all the owner wanted to do was add a few accent pieces.

The time it takes to wrap the trim is much longer than most people would think. The amount of detail to wrap around apart so as to cover all the chrome is why we have experienced installers. Our crew has years of experience applying vinyl to all manner of vehicles and parts.

Speak to our installation team about full-colour change ideas and partial wraps at 416-746-1381. Vinyl Wrap Toronto also does small decals, logos, or racing stripes. Click here to view more car wraps.

Or Visit our garage to see samples of the vinyl we use at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit #1, Etobicoke, M9W 1B4.
